_comment: OUR roles — the platform lane, and it is not the tenant lane.
These carry platform.* capabilities, which no establishment role ever does. They are seeded
once, under the reserved platform tenant, and they must not appear in an establishment's role
list at all: not greyed out, not filtered in the console, absent from the response.
SPLIT BY JOB, NOT BY RANK. Finance has two capabilities and support has none that write. An
operator who works on commission cannot edit a template, and an incident stays inside the job
it belongs to. A single 'staff' role with everything would be one compromised laptop away from
every establishment on the product.
TWO NAMES THAT LOOK REDUNDANT BUT ARE NOT: 'platform.identity' AND 'members:read'/
'members:write' on platform-owner. identity-service's own admin_actions.py never checks
'platform.identity' at all — its member-directory routes gate on the literal capability
strings IDENTITY_MEMBERS_READ_CAP/_WRITE_CAP default to ('members:read'/'members:write'),
which is unrelated naming this file used to leave ungranted entirely. The only reason a seeded
owner could ever add/edit/suspend/remove a member was seed-admin.sh's own bootstrap call
hard-coding 'members:write' onto that one account directly — never through this role, and never
including 'members:read' at all, so even a seeded owner could add a member but never list the
roster. Both are declared explicitly here now, the same way every other capability on this file
is, so a NEW platform-owner minted through the panel itself (not the bootstrap script) gets full
member-directory access too, not just the one seeded from outside.
ANOTHER PAIR THAT LOOKS REDUNDANT BUT ISN'T: 'platform.secrets' AND 'platform.secrets_manage'.
'platform.secrets' is the per-service operator/secrets route every OURS service inherits from
_template — an operator setting THAT SERVICE's own runtime config/credentials (a payment key,
a delivery driver's token) through its own runtime_config/secret_store. 'platform.secrets_manage'
is secrets-admin's own, unrelated capability — rewriting the EXTERNAL PROVIDER secrets (Meta's
app secret, Gemini's API key, ...) sealed into other services' own K8s Secret objects, write-
only, never read back. Holding one implies nothing about the other; platform-owner holds both
because it holds everything, not because they are the same door.
A THIRD PAIR THAT WAS FOUND MISSING, NOT JUST DOCUMENTED: 'platform.billing' (billing-service's
own operator/coupons route — billing.list_coupons) and 'billing.manage' (plans/pricing —
billing.list_plans/update_plan/plan_availability) are two different capabilities on the same
service. platform-owner had the first and not the second, which the AdminApps.tsx screen made
visible: the whole Plans & pricing section rendered nothing at all, not even an empty state,
because there was no action to key it on — found live, then fixed here. Explicit, not starred,
same reason as every other capability on this file.
A FOURTH ONE, SAME SHAPE: 'notifications.templates' (notification-service's WhatsApp template
list/register/submit routes) was never granted to ANY role at all — not missing from one role
next to a sibling that had it, absent everywhere, because the admin screen that reaches it
(AdminWhatsAppTemplates.tsx) was built the same day this was found. platform-owner gets it as
everything-owner; platform-operator too, since its own description already names 'مكتبة
القوالب' (the template library) as squarely its job.

roles.name: platform-owner
roles.label: مالك المنصة
roles.description: كل صلاحيات المنصة، ومنح الأدوار. مكتوبة صراحةً لا بنجمة — والنجمة تمنح كل صلاحية تُضاف مستقبلاً لمن لم يوافق عليه أحد.

roles.name: platform-affiliates
roles.label: إدارة المسوّقين
roles.description: بوابة القبول لطلبات المسوّقين — قبول، رفض، إيقاف، إعادة تفعيل. مراجعة من يستفيد من انضمام المسوّق لا تُفوَّض له نفسه (بوابة المسوّقين، §٢) — دور منفصل عن المالية عمداً: هذا قرار «مين يصير مسوّقاً»، لا تسوية عمولة.

roles.name: platform-operator
roles.label: مشغّل المنصة
roles.description: المحتوى والحدود: مكتبة القوالب، وسقوف الإرسال، والشركاء. لا فوترة ولا حذف مستأجر.

roles.name: platform-support
roles.label: الدعم الفني
roles.description: قراءة في كل مكان، وكتابة في لا مكان. يقرأ سجلّ محل ليجيب «لماذا لم تصل الرسالة؟» — وهو السؤال الوحيد الذي يولّده هذا المنتج — ولا يستطيع تغيير سقفٍ ولا قالبٍ ولا حملة وهو هناك. ودعمٌ يستطيع الكتابة خرقٌ ينتظر مساءً مرهقاً.

roles.name: platform-finance
roles.label: المالية
roles.description: كشوف الشركاء والعمولات والفواتير. لا قوالب ولا قطاعات — من يسوّي عمولةً لا يعدّل نصّ رسالة.

roles.name: platform-backup
roles.label: مشغّل النسخ
roles.description: تشغيل النسخ الاحتياطي ومراقبته واستعادته. صلاحيتان، وهو الدور الذي يجب أن يُستدعى في أسوأ يوم — فلا يحمل شيئاً يمكن أن يُخطئ فيه في الأيام العادية.
